worldcombat.skill.coil.summary: The user coils its body tighter and tighter and focuses, then springs open: Attack, Defence and accuracy each rise by one stage. It is the slowest and most complete move of the family, holding the longest visible window; when the brace ends, those three stats are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.coil.use.0: Coil once before the fight to raise Attack, Defence and accuracy together
worldcombat.skill.coil.use.1: Pin all three down before bracing a burst of physical pressure
worldcombat.skill.coil.use.2: Coil your cut accuracy back into line
worldcombat.skill.coil.description.0: Once braced, Attack rises by %1$s, Defence by %2$s and accuracy by %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.coil.description.1: The brace lasts %1$s; when it ends the three stages it raised are taken back.
worldcombat.skill.coil.tight.on: Tight: Defence rises one more stage and the brace window is multiplied by 1.25, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up, 15 ticks more cooldown and a slower coil.
worldcombat.skill.coil.tight.off: Loose: Defence only +1, but faster to raise, with a shorter cooldown and a crisp recovery.
worldcombat.skill.coil.timing: A self move with %1$s blocks of range; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.coil.growth.0: At level %1$s the brace window stretches to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.coil.growth.1: At level %1$s the brace window stretches further to %2$s.
On: Defence rises one more stage and the brace window is multiplied by 1.25, at the cost of a 4-tick longer wind-up, 15 ticks more cooldown and a slower coil. Off: loose, faster with a shorter cooldown and a crisp recovery, but Defence only +1.
worldcombat.skill.coil.preference.ai.max: The move is considered only against a threat within this distance; larger means coiling earlier.
worldcombat.skill.coil.preference.ai.min: A threat closer than this makes the companion attack instead of coiling; it is more cautious than its kin, so lowering it makes the brace more likely up close.
